g.text: BIEU DO TUAN TU DA TANG (MULTI-TIER SEQUENCE DIAGRAM)
LUONG CHAM CONG THOI GIAN THUC & CHOT CA TU DONG
Luong 1: Check-in Ca Lam Viec Thoi Gian Thuc
Chon ca lam hom nay & Bam "Check-in Ca Lam"
SELECT * FROM cham_cong WHERE ma_nv=3 AND ma_ca=1 AND ngay_lam=CURRENT_DATE
SELECT * FROM phan_ca WHERE ma_nv=3 AND ngay_lam=CURRENT_DATE AND ma_ca=1
INSERT INTO cham_cong (ma_phan_ca, ma_nv, ma_ca, ngay_lam, gio_check_in, trang_thai, so_phut_tre)
HTTP 200 OK (Chi tiet ban ghi cham cong JSON)
Hien thi Toast: "Check-in thanh cong: " + trangThai
Cap nhat trang thai ca sang mau xanh
Luong 2: Check-out Ca Lam Viec Thoi Gian Thuc
SELECT * FROM cham_cong WHERE ma_nv=3 AND ma_ca=1 AND ngay_lam=CURRENT_DATE
UPDATE cham_cong SET gio_check_out=now, so_gio_lam=?, gio_cong_quy_doi=? WHERE ma_cham_cong=45
Hien thi thong bao check-out thanh cong kem tong so gio cong
Luong 3: Chot Ca Tu Dong Dinh Ky (@Scheduled Cron)
[Tung ca lam da ket thuc trong ngay (now > caLam.gioKetThuc)]
SELECT pc.* FROM phan_ca pc WHERE pc.ma_ca=? AND pc.ngay_lam=? AND pc.ma_phan_ca NOT IN (SELECT cc.ma_phan_ca FROM cham_cong cc)
Danh sach nhan vien vang mat
INSERT INTO cham_cong (ma_phan_ca, ma_nv, ma_ca, ngay_lam, trang_thai, so_gio_lam, gio_cong_quy_doi, ghi_chu)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, CURRENT_DATE, 'VANG', 0, 0, 'He thong tu dong ghi nhan vang')
SELECT * FROM cham_cong WHERE ma_ca=? AND ngay_lam=? AND gio_check_in IS NOT NULL AND gio_check_out IS NULL
UPDATE cham_cong SET trang_thai='QUEN_CHECK_OUT', so_gio_lam=0, gio_cong_quy_doi=0 WHERE ma_cham_cong=?
